headline: A 2020 law renamed the Thomasville, Alabama post office at 115 Nicol Avenue in honor of former postmaster Robert Ingram.
what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 115 Nicol Avenue in Thomasville, Alabama, the "Postmaster Robert Ingram Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 17, 2020, and the new name applies from that date.
